authority: Valuation and Property Services Department, Ministry of Finance Malaysia

fields.description: Unique statutory identifier generated upon Form 14A stamping lodgement
State identifier (e.g. 10: Selangor, 14: WP Kuala Lumpur, 01: Johor)
Housing estate or commercial development project name (Taman / Seksyen)
Land tenure category under National Land Code
Remaining lease years at date of transaction (applicable for Leasehold)
Specific typology: 1-Storey Terraced, 2-Storey Semi-Detached, Condominium, Shop-Office 3-Storey
Cadastral land parcel area in square meters
Main floor area (MFA) + Ancillary floor area (AFA) in square meters
Stated contract price agreed between buyer and seller in Ringgit Malaysia
Independent fair market value assessed by JPPH valuation officer for stamp duty baseline
Analyzed unit rate in MYR per square meter of land or built-up area
Date stated on Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA)
Date when stamp duty was paid and transfer endorsed
